# QRCoder 1.8.1

`QRCoder.dll` is the unmodified .NET Framework 4.0 assembly from the [official NuGet package](https://www.nuget.org/packages/QRCoder/1.8.1). It is embedded into Android Mirror at build time, so users do not need an additional installation.

- Source: https://github.com/Shane32/QRCoder/tree/d050cc7c0bc986f14cfedf24b947e0ec5c1a7736
- Licence: [MIT](../../licenses/QRCoder-LICENSE.txt)
- SHA-256: `912272105F42564AC49693F997CDE1B05C3BB5D1A7640B555CD2BF6CD852348C`

The build verifies this hash before compilation. Package metadata is retained in `QRCoder.nuspec`.
